_about: Independent synthetic retrieval evaluation labels, written without reference to any ranker, to test whether peer retrieval is fooled by LOOK-ALIKE INVENTED COMPANY NAMES. Real data in this format has invented names such as 'Irovaiva Air Group' and 'Irovaor Fibre Inc', and each description starts with the company's own name; companies in unrelated businesses whose names share a prefix then look similar. Here 14 invented name stems are each shared by 5 companies in 5 different businesses and sectors (with slightly varied endings), while the true peers of every business carry names from different stems, so names never help find true peers. Each description opens with the company's full name and may repeat the short name once. All companies are invented and carry correct sector/industry/sub_industry fields (no mislabels). Graded labels are derived mechanically from the hand-written taxonomy: 3 same business, 2 same industry but different business, 1 same sector but different industry, 0 different sector. Tags: every company is 'lookalike_name'; 'cross_country' is computed (none of its same-business peers is in its own country). Splits alternate dev/held_out inside every business.
